name: Can't be broken
theme: The Shellwardens of Kesh: a coastal people who grow living coral over their bodies and hold the tide-gates; they do not fall

name: Kills brutally
does: removes enemy units, many and hard
theme: The Ashen Hunt: riders on burn-scarred lizards who sweep the dune seas and leave nothing standing

name: Messes you up
does: breaks the enemy's units and plans
theme: The Whisper Choir: masked singers whose songs unknit memory, break oaths and turn warriors against their orders

name: Moves
does: wins by where its units and his stand
theme: The Drift Clans: sky-raft nomads who ride the winds between floating islands and shove their foes off the edges

name: Thrives on spells
does: spells that get stronger, cheaper and more of them
theme: The Lantern Scribes: scholars who write with ink distilled from starlight; every word they write makes the next one brighter

name: Waits
does: gets bigger every round, clears the board, then plays huge cards
theme: The Deep Bell: an old order inside the mountain that winds a vast clockwork for years, then rings the bell that flattens the valley

name: Swarms
does: fills the board with many units that hit at once
theme: The Hive of Many Mouths: insect folk who hatch by the thousand from amber nests and cover the ground at once

name: Grows
does: its units get bigger and bigger
theme: The Rootborn: walking tree-giants who swell with every season they survive

name: Comes back
theme: The Returning Tide: drowned sailors the sea sends back to the shore every dawn

name: Eats its own
does: kills and spends its own units and cards for power
theme: The Ember Cult: fire-worshippers who feed their own to the furnace for power
